site.name: Ambystech Decks
site.description: Slide decks the Ambystech team presents in public: talks and lightning talks on the tools we build and the way we work. Open in the browser, no install.

categories.name: Talks
categories.title: Half an hour, one argument, a live demo.
categories.body: Conference and meetup talks. Each one makes a single case and shows it working.

categories.name: Lightning
categories.title: Ten minutes, one idea.
categories.body: Short talks for meetups, client sessions and internal demos.

decks.title: Tu siguiente usuario es un agente
decks.pitch: Cómo preparar tu producto para que los agentes de IA lo usen.
decks.description: How to get your product ready for AI agents. An agent acting for a customer reads your tools, not your interface. Four design rules, and a live demo of one agent against two ticket sellers: an official one and a resale one.
decks.event: Monterrey AI Talks · Monterrey Tech Week
decks.speaker: Gustavo Barrientos

decks.title: AmbyKit
decks.pitch: Spec-Driven Development that specs your UI too.
decks.description: Why AI coding assistants ship interfaces nobody asked for, and how one neutral spec with a UI design phase generates native commands for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and others.
decks.speaker: Gustavo Barrientos

present.title: Plain HTML. No runtime. No Wi-Fi needed.
present.body: Every deck here is built with Axo, our static deck framework. Slides are MDX; the output is plain HTML that runs from a USB stick. The source lives in the decks repository.
facts: Compiled to plain HTML, no React or hydration
Runs offline and exports to PDF
